summary: multiple_scattering.py solved the crossover and MDR with one velocity for every rigidity (beta fixed, 1 by default), so for slow particles both were off.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the defective code is in the script as first released (hep-research 0.3.0, commit 351029c0)

observables: crossover rigidity and maximum detectable rigidity (MDR) of multiple_scattering.py
impact.bias: the proton crossover of the prototype stack is 1.534037 GV with beta(R) and was 1.3087 GV with beta = 1; the shift grows for heavier, slower species
impact.trigger: a crossover or MDR of a particle that is not relativistic near that rigidity (protons and nuclei at a few GV)

outputs.how_to_recognize: JSON on stdout with crossover_rigidity_gv, mdr_definition and mdr_intrinsic_only_gv (geant4_benchmarks.py runs it as a subprocess)

remedy: rerun multiple_scattering.py with --mass or --species on a release that has the fix
